claims.claim: Paech warns that his Slop Score analysis is optimised for creative writing and essays and will likely under-report slop in other domains.
claims.source: Sam Paech, 'Slop Score' explainer page, EQ-Bench (eqbench.com), read 6 Sep 2026
claims.page: 'How does this work?' panel, 'Tips for the Analysis Tool'

claims.claim: Wiher, Meister and Cotterell found the diversity-quality trade-off in language generation to be strongly task-specific rather than a single property of a decoding rule.
claims.source: Gian Wiher, Clara Meister and Ryan Cotterell, 'On Decoding Strategies for Neural Text Generators', TACL 2022 (arXiv v1, 29 Mar 2022)

claims.claim: Wiher and colleagues measured degenerate repetition in under one percent of generations for every task they tested except story generation.
claims.source: Gian Wiher, Clara Meister and Ryan Cotterell, 'On Decoding Strategies for Neural Text Generators', TACL 2022 (arXiv v1, 29 Mar 2022)
claims.quote: for all tasks besides SG, we see repet
claims.page: section 5, Repetitions (the quotation breaks at a line-wrapped hyphen; the sentence continues 'itive behaviour in less than 1% of generations')

claims.claim: In Wiher and colleagues' story-generation table, greedy decoding degenerated into repetition in 95.67 percent of generations from the small model against 0 percent for the human reference.
claims.source: Gian Wiher, Clara Meister and Ryan Cotterell, 'On Decoding Strategies for Neural Text Generators', TACL 2022 (arXiv v1, 29 Mar 2022)
claims.page: Table 5 (Story Gen. (small), % repetition, rows Greedy and Reference)

claims.claim: Wiher and colleagues report that string diversity across a set of generations shows little consistency from one task to another.
claims.source: Gian Wiher, Clara Meister and Ryan Cotterell, 'On Decoding Strategies for Neural Text Generators', TACL 2022 (arXiv v1, 29 Mar 2022)

claims.claim: In Hewitt and colleagues' adversarial repetition test on GPT-2 large, top-p continued an injected repetition in 47 percent of completions against 26 percent for their eta-sampling.
claims.source: John Hewitt, Christopher D. Manning and Percy Liang, 'Truncation Sampling as Language Model Desmoothing', Findings of EMNLP 2022 (arXiv v1, 27 Oct 2022)
claims.page: Table 4 (Repetition Percent, column lg, rows top-p and eta-sampling)

claims.claim: Hewitt and colleagues built their repetition stress test from the opening words of the Wikipedia biographies of the 101 most-read people.
claims.source: John Hewitt, Christopher D. Manning and Percy Liang, 'Truncation Sampling as Language Model Desmoothing', Findings of EMNLP 2022 (arXiv v1, 27 Oct 2022)

claims.claim: Hewitt and colleagues' human raters preferred eta-sampling continuations over top-p continuations by 53 percent to 40 percent.
claims.source: John Hewitt, Christopher D. Manning and Percy Liang, 'Truncation Sampling as Language Model Desmoothing', Findings of EMNLP 2022 (arXiv v1, 27 Oct 2022)
claims.page: section 5.2, Results (the quotation begins mid-word from a line-wrapped hyphen in 'preferred')

claims.claim: Shi and colleagues found that the choice of decoding method matters less once a model has been alignment-tuned, the spread between best and worst decoders narrowing sharply.
claims.source: Chufan Shi, Haoran Yang, Deng Cai, Zhisong Zhang, Yifan Wang, Yujiu Yang and Wai Lam, 'A Thorough Examination of Decoding Methods in the Era of LLMs', EMNLP 2024 (arXiv v3, 8 Oct 2024)
claims.quote: less critical after the model is aligned
claims.page: section 4.1, 'Aligned models are less dependent on decoding methods than unaligned models'

claims.claim: Shi and colleagues measured the average next-token entropy of Llama2-7B-Chat on Wikinews at 0.52 against 2.37 for the unaligned Llama2-7B.
claims.source: Chufan Shi, Haoran Yang, Deng Cai, Zhisong Zhang, Yifan Wang, Yujiu Yang and Wai Lam, 'A Thorough Examination of Decoding Methods in the Era of LLMs', EMNLP 2024 (arXiv v3, 8 Oct 2024)
claims.page: Table 2 (column Wikinews, rows Llama2-7B and Llama2-7B-Chat)

claims.claim: Shi and colleagues explain the narrowed decoder gap partly by the aligned model producing far fewer repetitions even under deterministic decoding such as greedy search.
claims.source: Chufan Shi, Haoran Yang, Deng Cai, Zhisong Zhang, Yifan Wang, Yujiu Yang and Wai Lam, 'A Thorough Examination of Decoding Methods in the Era of LLMs', EMNLP 2024 (arXiv v3, 8 Oct 2024)
claims.quote: the aligned model produces much fewer repetitions

claims.claim: Zhang and colleagues report that their prompting strategy is orthogonal to the decoding strategy and can be layered on top of top-p and min-p.
claims.source: Jiayi Zhang, Simon Yu, Derek Chong, Anthony Sicilia, Michael R. Tomz, Christopher D. Manning and Weiyan Shi, 'Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity', arXiv v4, 15 Jul 2026
claims.quote: it is orthogonal to the decoding strategy
claims.page: Appendix F.3, Ablation on Decoding Strategies

claims.claim: Zhang and colleagues measured a 1.6 to 2.1 times increase in creative-writing diversity from Verbalized Sampling over direct prompting.
claims.source: Jiayi Zhang, Simon Yu, Derek Chong, Anthony Sicilia, Michael R. Tomz, Christopher D. Manning and Weiyan Shi, 'Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity', arXiv v4, 15 Jul 2026

claims.claim: In Zhang and colleagues' Prolific study of 90 annotators, Verbalized Sampling scored 3.06 for story diversity on a four-point scale against 2.74 for direct prompting.
claims.source: Jiayi Zhang, Simon Yu, Derek Chong, Anthony Sicilia, Michael R. Tomz, Christopher D. Manning and Weiyan Shi, 'Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity', arXiv v4, 15 Jul 2026
claims.page: Table 2 (Human-rated diversity, row Story, columns Direct and VS-Standard)

claims.claim: Zhang and colleagues confirmed that post-training reduces output diversity at every stage they tested, supervised fine-tuning, RLHF and RLVR.
claims.source: Jiayi Zhang, Simon Yu, Derek Chong, Anthony Sicilia, Michael R. Tomz, Christopher D. Manning and Weiyan Shi, 'Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity', arXiv v4, 15 Jul 2026
